login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to see your orders and saved details.
login.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

register.demoNote: Demo only: DummyJSON replied with a new user (#{{id}}) but does not save it, so you can't sign in as {{username}}. Use the demo account on the sign-in page instead.
register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Track orders, save addresses, and check out faster.
register.emailHint: We'll email you a code to confirm it.
register.phoneHint: With the country code, like +880 1712 345678. For delivery updates.
register.usernameHint: 3–30 characters: letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores.
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
register.terms: I agree to the terms of service and privacy policy.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a 6-digit code to choose a new password.
forgot.demoSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, you'll receive a code shortly.
forgot.demoNote: Demo only: no email was sent. DummyJSON has no password-reset API.
forgot.changed: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
forgot.emailed: If an account exists for {{email}}, we emailed it a 6-digit code. It expires in 10 minutes.
forgot.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.start: Start by <register>creating an account</register> or <signin>signing in</signin>: we'll email you a code.
verify.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it below to confirm your email. The code expires in 10 minutes.

resend.sent: We sent a new code to {{email}}. Earlier codes no longer work.

session.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
